author: musho7-dev
subject: Fix on-screen shaking at speed: physics interpolation, physics-rate camera
body:
The car itself moved smoothly (0.03 px jerk per physics step), but on
screen it jiggled 1-2 px every frame: physics steps and screen frames
didn't line up (some frames got 2 steps, some 0) while the camera moved
per frame, and the camera's zoom and look-ahead followed the raw,
bump-noisy speed.

- Enable 2D physics interpolation so bodies are drawn between steps
- Camera follows in the physics step, together with the car
- Camera zoom and look-ahead use a smoothed speed
- Self-test measures on-screen jiggle; it dropped from 1.0-1.9 to
  0.04-0.2 px/frame, including the fastest maxed car on Neon City
